schemaProvenance.input: Verbatim inputSchema string returned by the fixed build endpoint.
schemaProvenance.dataset: Verbatim actorDefinition.storages.dataset.fields returned by the fixed build endpoint.
schemaProvenance.actorOutput: Verbatim actorDefinition.output returned by the fixed build endpoint.
schemaProvenance.warning: Field presence and runtime values are not guaranteed by this schema. It declares every dataset field as required; historical integration notes for sibling Actors show that Actor output can omit fields the schema marks required. Treat this document as a schema snapshot, not a runtime guarantee.

videoUrl.title: The URL of the facebook
videoUrl.description: The URL of the facebook you want to get the data from.

absentFields.bulkUrls: Not present in this Actor. Batch work requires one Run per URL.
absentFields.usernames: Not present in this Actor. There is no profile mode.
absentFields.sessionid: Not present in this Actor. Public videos only.

actorOutput.title: Output schema of Social media scraper

output.cardinality: unknown; one Run per URL is expected to yield one item, but the schema does not constrain it

speech2text.title: Cost-Effective Audio-to-Text (Auto)
speech2text.note: Documented as $0.002 to $0.0045 per minute depending on plan; any duration under one minute is billed as one minute.

pricing.storePageClaimScope: Covers the dataset-item event only; it does not include the speech2text event.

limits.freePlanSource: Actor README: free users can only try video transcription with a duration of no more than 5 minutes.
limits.paidPlanDurationLimit: Documented as not limited by duration.
limits.audioOnly: The Actor transcribes audio; text burned into video frames is not extracted.
